Session slowdown by budget and mutual divergence (messages per side), measured in virtual time against the same divergence under an unbounded budget. The link is latency-only, so these are worst-case factors — independent of the delay itself — and a real link's bandwidth absorbs them: once transfer time exceeds window stall (dispute throughput `budget / (3 × RTT)` at or above the link rate), the factor is 1.

| budget | 1k | 10k | 50k |
|---|---|---|---|
| 256 KiB | 9.6× | 36.5× | 97.7× |
| 1 MiB | 3.0× | 14.1× | 26.5× |
| 4 MiB | 1.2× | 3.9× | 7.6× |
| 16 MiB | 1.0× | 1.3× | 1.5× |
| 64 MiB | 1.0× | 1.0× | 1.1× |
| 128 MiB (default) | 1.0× | 1.0× | 1.1× |
